notes: Hard links counted once by (st_dev, st_ino) unless the key says otherwise.
allocated_* = st_blocks*512, which reports every APFS clone at full size; physical_estimate_clones_once subtracts the extents the generator knows are shared.
unreadable/locked is chmod 000 after the walk: a non-root scanner should match visible_to_non_root.
pathmax/ holds a path longer than PATH_MAX (1024) with an 8 MiB file at the bottom.
